(?fsm:record_output

  (+types
    (type frame (record (kind (bits 2)) (payload (record (data (signed (four_state (bits 5)))) (flags (list bit (two_state (bits 2))))))))
  )

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input incoming)
    (output packet)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
    (internal held)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (incoming frame)
    (packet frame)
    (seen 5)
    (done 1)
    (held frame)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<start
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (held incoming))
    (-> main_set_2)
  )

  (main_set_2
    (<- (packet> held))
    (-> main_set_3)
  )

  (main_set_3
    (<- (seen> packet.payload.data))
    (-> main_done_4)
  )

  (main_done_4
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)

source:
(actor record_output
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n sync active_low))
  (types
    (type frame
      (record
        (kind (bits 2))
        (payload
          (record
            (data (signed (four_state (bits 5))))
            (flags (list bit (two_state (bits 2)))))))))
  (interface
    (output packet (type frame))
    (input start)
    (input incoming (type frame))
    (output seen (width 5))
    (output done))
  (storage (var held (type frame)))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (set held incoming)
    (set packet held)
    (set seen packet.payload.data)
    (complete done)))
